cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Complete the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. For the party report, what time did you arrive, leave, and visit the kitchen?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. It's the only room missing from the timeline.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll give the cake its own line. First, your kitchen time.
